}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:44.519
    | text      = But last we left off, Charlie Kirk had been shot and killed at a speaking event he was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = holding at the campus of Utah Valley University.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:52.319
    | text      = Alex had exploitatively aired the video of the shooting on a loop and had vowed to do
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:56.120
    | text      = his own college tour in Charlie's honor mere hours after it had come out that he had died.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:00.959
    | text      = Beautiful.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:01.959
    | text      = No one had any information about the shooter at that point, but it was reported confidently
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:05.519
    | text      = that this was a leftist assassin from Antifa and that the shooting was part of the Podesta
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:10.399
    | text      = Revolutionary Plan that was crafted in 2020 but was put on the shelf for four years because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:15.040
    | text      = Trump lost that election so there was no need for revolution.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:17.879
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:18.879
    | text      = It was a disgusting display, but nothing too surprising to see from Alex's show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:23.519
    | text      = When we recorded our last episode, we didn't know anything about who the shooter could
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:26.800
    | text      = be either, and I tried to be pretty clear about how it was unwise to jump to any conclusions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:31.639
    | text      = The person could easily have been someone motivated by left-leaning political ideology
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:35.120
    | text      = who hated Charlie, but Charlie had a lot of enemies on the far right as well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:39.199
    | text      = Someone from that world could have killed him, or the killer could have even been apolitical
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:42.879
    | text      = in their motivation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:44.839
    | text      = I pushed back on Alex's assertions that it was a leftist shooter not because I know that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:48.839
    | text      = to be incorrect, but because I know that Alex is making that accusation baselessly, and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:54.199
    | text      = it's the kind of response that he embodies does nobody any good and can only cause trouble.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:00.040
    | text      = Now that we're here and a little more information is known about the shooting, details are still
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:04.279
    | text      = a bit sketchy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:05.720
    | text      = A 22-year-old man named Tyler Robinson has been arrested for the shooting, having allegedly
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:09.839
    | text      = confessed to his dad, who then was involved in helping turn him into authorities.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:14.800
    | text      = It appears that Robinson's father was torn about what he should do once he figured out
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:18.459
    | text      = that his son was the one who had committed the murder, so he consulted with his church
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:22.160
    | text      = leader.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:23.160
    | text      = Should he turn in his son to face a possible death sentence or stay silent about his son's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:27.839
    | text      = guilt in order to save his life?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:29.600
    | text      = It was a moral dilemma that the dad faced, and it turns out that the church does not
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:34.059
    | text      = have a no-snitching policy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:35.200
    | text      = I was gonna say, I feel like just by doing that you have already decided which one you're
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:39.159
    | text      = gonna do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:40.159
    | text      = Yeah, I think you're, well, you know it's interesting because I do think if you were
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:45.279
    | text      = thrust into that situation it might be good to seek counsel of some kind.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:48.879
    | text      = I agree.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:49.879
    | text      = But I think if you're going to talk to somebody like a priest, you're hoping that they'll
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:53.639
    | text      = take the responsibility off your shoulders.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:55.759
    | text      = That would kind of be the idea.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:56.879
    | text      = I feel like you're begging someone else to, look, I don't want to turn in my son, can
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:01.320
    | text      = you please do it?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:02.320
    | text      = Yeah, especially if you're, I mean it's not like a confessional, it's not like you're
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:06.879
    | text      = like, hey, we both agree, nothing leaves this room kind of situation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:11.240
    | text      = And I think even then, you know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:13.879
    | text      = Confessionals are still like, we report murders.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:16.799
    | text      = You can't, we don't absolve murders totally.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:20.799
    | text      = Unless the church has a no-snitching policy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:22.559
    | text      = Which I mean, there are probably churches, but we don't know about them for obvious reasons.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:27.440
    | text      = No one talks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:28.440
    | text      = No one's snitching, exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:30.019
    | text      = So law enforcement has identified Robinson and also released information about messages
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:34.639
    | text      = that he'd allegedly written on the bullet casings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:38.080
    | text      = In the case of the assassination of the United Healthcare CEO, Luigi Mangione, there were
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:42.759
    | text      = messages inscribed on the bullets saying delay, deny, and depose.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:47.220
    | text      = The meaning of these words were clear, as they describe the strategy that insurance
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:50.480
    | text      = companies use to avoid having to pay for people's medical care.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:54.639
    | text      = Without endorsing anything that he did, these words being put on the bullets represents
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:58.340
    | text      = a coherent political message that could explain the killing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:02.679
    | text      = In this case, the messages that were on the bullets were essentially shitposts, and they
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:05.860
    | text      = don't really point to any definite ideology.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:09.200
    | text      = One said quote, hey fascist, catch.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:11.759
    | text      = Then arrows indicating up right down down down.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:15.519
    | text      = This is a, you know there's an instinct to say that this is an indication of like some
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:18.820
    | text      = anti-fascist tendencies on the part of the shooter, but this is just a reference to the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:22.840
    | text      = video game Helldivers 2.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:25.399
    | text      = The messages that were inscribed on the bullets don't point to a coherent motive, but point
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:29.159
    | text      = to a familiarity with being too online.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:32.840
    | text      = These were jokes that have an irony to them, and anybody taking them literally or at face
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:37.379
    | text      = value is not on the right track with this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:45.480
    | text      = You can't look at this without sort of decoding it through online culture.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:50.039
    | text      = Any time I have read anything about this, my first instinct was like, none of the people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:57.240
    | text      = writing about this should be allowed to write about this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:00.000
    | text      = There is a culture that understands what is going on, and we are not part of that culture.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:05.480
    | text      = And the people trying to translate it to me are not part of that culture either, and they're
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:09.360
    | text      = not doing a good job.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:10.360
    | text      = Yeah, and far be it from me to say that I'm drenched in this culture, I don't fully understand
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:17.120
    | text      = a whole lot of the way too online irony that people engage in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:21.759
    | text      = Nope, not even a little bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:22.840
    | text      = But I see another language when it's being spoken.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:26.840
    | text      = Yeah, exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:27.840
    | text      = No, I mean, any time back in the past, and I'm talking about the past before the QAnon,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:32.919
    | text      = any time something from 4chan leaked out, it was like, guys, don't get near it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:38.600
    | text      = You'll never understand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:40.519
    | text      = This is not for you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:41.659
    | text      = Just let it be in its space.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:43.519
    | text      = And now there's just a million different versions of that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:46.200
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:47.200
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:48.200
    | text      = So while it doesn't indicate whether he was on the left or the right politically, this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:51.080
    | text      = sends a clear message that the shooter is not a sincere communicator, and that he was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:55.480
    | text      = likely a person who came of age surrounded by shitty internet irony.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:59.639
    | text      = As it stands, I still don't know enough to have strong feelings about the motive of the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:03.000
    | text      = crime.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:04.000
    | text      = I think a lot of people want to jump to conclusions that he's a leftist or that he's a Nick Fuentes
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:09.080
    | text      = fan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:10.080
    | text      = And while all of these things are possible, I don't see anything concrete about it as
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:14.360
    | text      = of the time that we're recording.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:16.200
    | text      = I mean, to a certain extent, it's almost a...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:22.000
    | text      = I suppose I would say it's something new.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:25.000
    | text      = It's a shot from somewhere that we're not familiar with.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:28.759
    | text      = This isn't the left or the right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:30.600
    | text      = This is a whole culture.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:32.840
    | text      = The only thing I would push back on that is that it's fully new.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:35.440
    | text      = I think we've seen a fair amount of it in the last years.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:38.080
    | text      = Oh, no, no, no, for sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:39.080
    | text      = Yeah, absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:40.080
    | text      = I just mean in terms of our paradigm of how to classify this, this doesn't fit into what
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.299
    | text      = we would use 20 years ago.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:47.279
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:48.279
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:49.279
    | text      = This is of the now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:52.240
    | text      = There's a shifting of the understanding of motivations that we need to take into account.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:59.840
    | text      = Political ideology is far more fractured.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:02.600
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:03.600
    | text      = So Alex, he left his show on Wednesday and then came back and yelled a little bit over
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:11.679
    | text      = Harrison.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:13.019
    | text      = What a great guy.
}}

    | text      = And then did his special report.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:15.519
    | text      = And now here on the 11th, Alex starts off the show and, you know, just pointing some
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:45.519

    | text      = This is a real cult that believes it owns our children.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
